'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Garrett Larson LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Feel The Conflict]]
* '''Username:''' deadbody
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
